description: boss-flush's boss turned about a diameter of its cap so the cap's rim dips a quarter of a tolerance, or two, into the plate on one side and lifts off it on the other. The cap and the plate's face are two planes a hair off parallel, which have no closed form in Arris (OpError::Unsupported, a quarter); from about a tolerance and a half they meet in a line, and the wall's section with the plate's face, an ellipse within a tolerance or two of the rim circle all the way round, is paved without the rim's own vertices (Fault::Split, a section edge of the face ends at a node nothing else reaches). The desired result is a clean union: the flush body within the tolerance, the generic one beyond (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
